items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: So I took Joe and them -- took Tito Puente, Tito Rodriguez down there, had a big thing up in North Philly

ctx.x: Yeah, around that time. Because I had went to Philly and asked the kids at one of the big dancers down there -- I say, "what do yall think about the Latin," you know. They say, "Yeah, man, bring somebody in." So I took Joe and them -- took Tito Puente, Tito Rodriguez down there, had a big thing up in North Philly -- big ballroom. It was packed.
